note: Authoritative common geography for the four North American live layers (precipitation_na, air_temperature_na, cloud_cover_na, wind_na). Every NA builder bins its own source grid onto this exact canvas, so the four overlays align in Google Earth. Degrees per pixel: 0.05 x 0.05 (square). This boundary is a bounding extent enclosing the buffered landmass; it does not imply valid source data everywhere — areas without valid source data stay transparent.
